look_here_first: Small fine-textured sedge with very narrow leaves and a compact cluster of several tiny spikes bearing spreading or reflexed perigynia.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Cyperaceae/Carex: grasslike sedges with sheathing leaves; the fruit is enclosed in a perigynium, and perigynium shape/beak/venation are often decisive for species ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: green to pale-yellow perigynia with short beaks

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dry to wet-mesic open forest and field habitat

lookalikes.differences: C. texensis is the smallest and finest-textured member of B105. Its narrow leaves and tiny clustered spikes contrast strongly with broad-leaved C. cherokeensis and the large winged fruits of C. tetrastachya.
